task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to With the left arm, position the dark mouse with slight textured sides left of the tea box with leafy design
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架与左臂一起，将带有轻微纹理的深色鼠标放置在绿叶设计的茶盒左侧
